# fastf 3.1.1 — one command to install on any Linux

A packaging release. The tool is unchanged from 3.1.0.

## One command for any Linux

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cristocola/fast-folder/main/packaging/linux/install.sh | sh
```

The script downloads the static release archive, checks it against the release's own `SHA256SUMS`, and unpacks the binary, the man pages, the completions, the desktop entry and the icons. It puts `fastf` on your PATH for you: root gets `/usr/local`, which is already there, and everyone else gets `~/.local` with `~/.local/bin` added to their shell profile. `FASTF_VERSION` pins a release and `PREFIX` chooses where it goes.

The script is [`packaging/linux/install.sh`](https://github.com/cristocola/fast-folder/blob/main/packaging/linux/install.sh). Read it before you run it.

## Upgrading

Run the installer again and it replaces what is there.
